full_details: Nick asked for a clearer lead into the orchard. Romeo's last word and the boy's first had come too close, and he had gone in a breath early twice. Burbage said it had gone, and the yard had wept. You backed the boy. You have seen a fraction of doubt spread through a scene like a crack through a pane, and the orchard is all pane. The lead is changed by two words. He comes in on the second of them, and not on the breath before it. The words go onto the roll and are not said into the room. Larkham marked the book and both rolls before anyone could carry off a rival memory of the old ones. The copies go on with his small sign. Burbage tried it and said it was better. Phillips called Nick to the lute, and told him to keep Saturday's note. The rest of the morning was the king Shoreditch already has. The three leaves stayed in the chest. You read a Rose bill, Harry the Fifth, and you did not cross the river. At two you were on in the Shrew. The house was ordinary. Kemp had his laugh on a line that was already in the book, and he did not ask you to write another.
one_sentence: You changed the boy's cue by two words, Larkham marked the book and both rolls, and in the afternoon the Shrew was an ordinary house.
title: Put two words on the boy's cue
